# Lecture - Evolution of the Solid Planets of Our Solar System - 2

In this mini-lecture, we think about the heat content of planets and what that tells
us about the age of the body and its thermal history.

It is probably helpful if you already had a look through the [Solar System Guidebook](../../slides/Slides-SS-SolidPlanets.html) and the previous set of [Lectures Slides](../../slides/Slides-PlanetaryGeophysics-1.html)
